item.title: We tested the 'first wooden, sustainable air purifier' and it's a thing of beauty
item.description: The IQAir Atem Earth is the most elegant, eco-friendly air purifier we have ever tested, and we absolutely love it for that. It is by no means flawless, though.

item.title: Research group claims preeclampsia doomed the Neanderthals, but experts say it's just a 'thought experiment'
item.description: Preeclampsia, a complication of pregnancy that involves high blood pressure, could have led to a decline in Neanderthals' fertility, a new study suggests.

item.title: Supercomputers simulated the orbits of 1 million satellites between Earth and the moon — and less than 10% survived
item.description: Researchers used a pair of powerful supercomputers to simulate the potential trajectories of 1 million satellites in a cislunar orbit between Earth and the moon. Less than 10% of these orbits remained stable throughout the simulations, but this is not as disastrous as it may sound.

item.title: The biggest trees in the Peruvian Amazon store the most carbon — and they also face the greatest threat from humans
item.description: The Amazon's biggest trees store disproportionately more carbon than smaller trees do, new study finds. But in the Peruvian Amazon, large trees are currently prioritized for harvest.

item.title: Save $150 on our cycling experts' recommended choice as the best cycling smart trainer, now at its lowest-ever price
item.description: We loved the original Wahoo Kickr Core; the latest iteration is even better, with a host of improvements, including improved accuracy, power meter, and virtual shifting with the brilliant Zwift Cog and Click system.

item.title: Microsoft can now store data for 10,000 years on everyday glass thanks to laser breakthrough
item.description: Improvements to the data writing and reading techniques, alongside a new way to store data, mean the technology is more accessible than before.

item.title: NASA starts countdown clock for second Artemis II wet dress rehearsal after rocky first attempt
item.description: NASA will attempt to fuel its Artemis II rocket again tomorrow after hydrogen leaks derailed the first wet dress rehearsal and delayed what is scheduled to be a historic crewed flight around the moon.

item.title: City-size, cold-volcano comet transforms into a glowing 'snail shell' after major explosive outburst
item.description: Following a massive cryovolcanic eruption, the mysterious Comet 29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann has been morphed into a giant spiral and is now shining 100 times brighter than normal.

item.title: 'Absolute surprise': Homo erectus skulls found in China are almost 1.8 million years old — the oldest evidence of the ancient human relatives in East Asia
item.description: A new date for Homo erectus skulls found in central China provides new insight into how and when ancient human relatives reached eastern Asia.

item.title: Physicists recreated the first millisecond after the Big Bang — and found it was surprisingly soupy
item.description: Scientists saw a quark plowing through primordial plasma for the first time, offering a rare look at the first moments after the Big Bang
